Rebuild the mapping independently, then use the observation to propose one further change. These 48 scalar values are a different experiment from the paired RGB grids.
magnets.final: Return to the opening assignment question with five trays. RGB triples and their means give the same sample different forms. Keep this as our first research pilot.

magnets.brief: Paired colour windows replay a seeded stream. The right window can change RGB assignment and output range while the left remains a baseline. Discarding one draw is a separate intervention.

magnets.final: Answer the replay question through visible arithmetic. Define pseudorandom procedure, state and seed only now; repeatability gives us an experiment we can revisit.

magnets.tutorial: Use beside the crank as a closer examination of the implementation.

magnets.final: An irregular trace challenges the eye: appearance alone does not establish a source of uncertainty.
